Renuka is locked up in a room thirsty and hungry for several days and is communicating with her girlfriend, Sunaina. Pratyush and Nishant are getting more closer to each other every passing day. Betrayal can sometimes be given by your own people. The trust is broken the enemies are known, how will Kabir survive?
